title: LLM-as-a-Demographic: Whom Sociodemographic Prompting Helps, and Whom It Hurts
reasoning: The paper evaluates the effect of sociodemographic prompting on LLMs' alignment with specific demographic groups' judgments on subjective tasks such as offensiveness, politeness, and intimacy. While it extensively studies demographic bias, race, and gender, it does not explicitly benchmark or evaluate moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religious topics.
